applies_why: This text decides that a cited verse was answered and therefore not counted as an unanswered witness, which is exactly what K-G4 governs.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
room: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it: one reading treats stating answered as sufficient to exclude it from unanswered witnesses; the other would require an express elsewhere statement that it is not counted. I adopt the first.
why: The judge labels Luke 2:48-49 answered and does not count it as an unanswered witness, so it obeys K-G4.
